title: IT is “migrating” your mailbox
scenario: A Teams message from “University IT” says your mailbox is being migrated and asks you to approve a Microsoft login and then authorize a new “Mail Transfer” app.

answers.A: Check whether a migration notice exists on the university IT status page before doing anything.
answers.B: Approve the login but refuse the app if its permissions look too broad.
answers.C: Deny the request and contact IT through the official help desk or portal.

explanation: A malicious OAuth app can access mail and files without stealing your password. Migration language makes broad permissions seem normal.
proTip: IT changes should be visible in IT’s real status channel.
